proposed_facts.reason: Canonical state-2 animation samples bone 1, tests the postdecrement's old value, enters state 4 when nonpositive and explicitly selects state 1 otherwise; it returns false.
The positive branch has no landing predicate or explicit velocity/fall-speed reset. The other state-1 entry paths establish the reset distinction described in the proposal.
Both canonical definition and header spell HSD_GObj*. The implementation retrieves Item and selects numeric state 2.

The source table and complete local callbacks support the five-state topology, strict sign guards and pre/postdecrement distinction. Shared landing predicates and animation dispatch support the exceptional branches and removal request. No compiled extent is asserted.

HSD_Randi(2) selects the two cues rather than alternating them. The registry explicitly identifies Bellossom. Sweet Scent and sleep-powder correspondence are retained gameplay context, not newly established effect-asset identity or direct sleep application.

The effect helper multiplies item scale by the reciprocal of 2.6f. Root-motion velocity is applied before the upper-only fall-speed cap and vertical overwrite; this callback does not advance the audio counter.

The wrapper supplies the preserving state-1 landing entry and returns false. The shared predicate chain includes destruction and entered_air handling, so callback suppression does not establish continued state-2 survival.

contradictions.reason: Accept supersession of both state-2 timer explanations and the incomplete topology: an old positive lifetime selects numeric state 1, not a hold in state 2. Collision transitions additionally require strict negative-to-positive signs.
Accept the exact-signature correction from Item_GObj* to canonical HSD_GObj* without claiming a distinct underlying ABI type.
Accept deferral of the .data extent claim: five source entries are supported, but an 80-byte compiled allocation is not established by the delivered source.
Accept all four .sdata2 deferrals. Literal uses, neutral values and effect normalization are supported independently; pool extent, contents and compiled section allocation remain unverified.
Accept correction of deterministic audio alternation to random selection while retaining the existing gameplay interpretation at its stated inference level.
Accept correction of 2.6f from resulting scale to scale divisor, including the persistent fall accumulator, upper-only cap and overwrite of root-motion vertical velocity.

Accept removal of the state-2 survival guarantee. Shared landing processing may destroy the item or dispatch entered_air handling before the supplied callback can run; this is a qualified shared-helper possibility, not a claim that every exceptional branch occurs for Bellossom.
Accept deferral of disappearance-causes-wakeup: ending entry and animation-driven item removal are supported, but the examined code does not establish fighter-side sleep termination.

unresolved: Compiled .data byte extent and .sdata2 contents/allocation remain unverified; source-level table entries and literal semantics remain supported.
Fighter-side sleep lifetime and wakeup linkage on Bellossom destruction remain unverified.

Supported inherited names, facts and links are retained. Sweet Scent and appearance names remain gameplay/role hypotheses, not recovered original names or independent proof of effect-asset identity. Acceptance covers the proposed changes and examined contradictions, not a new exhaustive audit of inherited retained rows.
